projects.title: Birthday Gift Web Experience
projects.description: An interactive birthday web experience designed to transform personal memories, photos, music, and heartfelt messages into a personalized digital journey. The project combines immersive visual presentation, smooth animations, interactive sections, and responsive layouts to create an engaging experience across desktop and mobile devices.
highlights: Interactive, story-driven birthday experience built around personalized memories and visual content.
Responsive layout optimized for both desktop and mobile screens.
Smooth animations and transitions designed to keep interactions natural and engaging.
Integrated background music to enhance the immersive experience.
Organized photo-based sections for presenting memories in a visually engaging format.
Deployed as a production-ready web experience.

projects.title: User Greeting & UI Component System
projects.description: A component system and user greeting interface built directly from custom Figma specifications into a modern, accessible React and TypeScript component suite.
highlights: Direct translation of Figma design specifications into React components
Accessible UI primitives built on Radix UI component library

projects.title: Daily Expense Tracker
projects.description: A lightweight, offline-first personal expense tracking application built with Flutter and Material 3. It helps users track daily spending, monitor weekly and monthly budget trends, categorize expenses, and export financial records locally without requiring an external backend.
highlights: Offline-first expense tracking with local JSON persistence
Complete expense CRUD with automatic balance recalculation
Interactive 7-day spending analytics and category breakdown
Local authentication and persistent user sessions

projects.title: AI Event Management & Recommendation System
projects.description: An AI-powered event management and recommendation platform featuring intelligent event recommendations, event discovery, intelligent search, digital ticketing, real-time communication, and B2B event services.
highlights: AI-driven event discovery & personalized recommendation pipeline
Digital ticketing with secure verification & attendee management
Real-time communication & live notifications powered by Socket.IO
